Title: Blood Brother Ambush and Consume the Dead

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Blood Brother Ambush
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Brujah antitribu
Cost: 2 blood
Only usable when an action is blocked.
Combat does not occur. Put this card into play. While in play, this card represents an ally with 3 life and 2 strength who can strike for 2R damage; this ally enters combat with the blocking minion. Blood Brother Ambush may play cards requiring basic Potence [pot] as a vampire with a capacity of 3. If a card would give them blood, give them life instead. Burn this card at the end of combat or if the combat is canceled.

Consume the Dead
Type: Action/Reaction
Requires: Nagaraja
[ACTION] +1 stealth action.  Enter combat with a wraith ally or burn a wraith retainer.
[REACTION] Only usable when a minion or retainer is being burned by any means except diablerie. Usable during combat. Usable by a tapped Nagaraja. Remove that minion or retainer from the game instead. This Nagaraja gains 1 blood if the minion was a vampire or gains X+1 blood, where X is the blood or pool cost of that ally or retainer. Burn option.

Blood Brother Ambush costs 2 blood
Blood Brother Ambush represents an ally with 3 life and 2 strength who can strike for 2R damage
Burn this card at the end of combat
Consume the Dead is Usable during combat
Only usable when a minion or retainer is being burned by any means except diablerie
This Nagaraja gains 1 blood if the minion was a vampire or gains X+1 blood, where X is the blood or pool cost of that ally or retainer.

Can you play a Blood Brother Ambush then Consume the Dead in the "End of Combat"
window to have your Nagaraja gain 3 blood?
Can you play a Blood Brother Ambush then Consume the Dead when your Blood Brother Ambush is burned from Combat damage to have your Nagaraja gain 3 blood?

Messages.Author: narpassword
Messages.Body:
Hangon - unless im missing something:

Consume the Dead is a reaction, useable during combat, but still a reaction.
Blood brother is a modifier - To play blood brother ambush, you need to be acting.

Messages.Author: Lech
Messages.Body:
I think you can play it while acting, as if fits specified window.

Sabbat.Black Hand Shakar: Lech loathe ranged weapons. Once each action, he may burn 1 blood to become Camarilla Prince of Krakow until the end of the action.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Lech wrote:
> I think you can play it while acting, as if fits specified window.
>
You can't play reactions while acting. It's a reaction that (unlike most reactions) is playable during combat, but it's still a reaction.
